title: Brake Free Smart LED Helmet Light
features: Built-in 3-axis accelerometer and gyroscope senses braking, engine braking, and downshifts
100 high-output red LEDs deliver 180° visibility placed directly in driver eye-line
Requires zero motorcycle wiring or wireless transceivers; 100% autonomous operation
Rechargeable Li-ion battery delivers 8–12 hours runtime; quick-release magnetic mount
description:
Designed to drastically enhance nighttime and bad-weather visibility, the Brake Free Smart LED Helmet Light from Brake Free puts dynamic deceleration lighting at driver eye level. Built with IP65 Weather-Sealed All-Weather Construction, it boasts an installation rating of 1.5 / 10 (Neodymium magnetic quick-mount bracket bonded via 3M VHB).

The Brake Free Smart LED Helmet Light from Brake Free significantly elevates rider conspicuity by placing high-intensity brake illumination right in the eye-line of following drivers, providing active protection during sudden deceleration.
